disqualifier.note: Only one boolean. The whoami writer always sets signedIn=true with stdout as account; unsigned-in is an error path, not a sibling flag. signedIn does not restate account presence.

Tolerant projection of `claude auth status` stdout JSON. loggedIn is the CLI's own field; email/authMethod/subscriptionType are independently optional CLI facts and may be absent while loggedIn is true.

Only one boolean. reason is an always-present diagnostic string for both true and false probes, not a payload whose presence is restated by webGl2. Backend pairing lives on already-recorded CosmosBackendSelection.
Firecrawl agent-start SDK wire subset; success and optional error are independently reported SDK fields copied at the driver boundary.
Firecrawl agent-status SDK wire; success is independent of the status literal and of optional error/data. Combined-true is a legal SDK payload, not a local exclusive phase.
Firecrawl browser-create SDK wire; success and optional error are independently reported SDK fields.
Firecrawl browser-delete SDK wire; success and optional error are independently reported SDK fields.
Firecrawl browser-list SDK wire; success and optional error are independently reported SDK fields.
obs-websocket RequestStatus wire object. result, code, and optional comment are independently reported protocol fields; result does not restate comment presence.
Projection of shacl-engine's report object. conforms and results are copied independently from the engine; combined-true is accepted here and only AND-filtered later into ShaclValidationResult.
